name: set_robust_list
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_set_robust_list, struct robust_list_head *head, size_t len);
description: The set_robust_list() system call informs the kernel of the head of the list of robust futexes owned by the calling thread. It is used to handle scenarios where a thread terminates without unlocking a futex, ensuring waiting threads are notified.

parameters.name: head
parameters.description: Pointer to the head of the robust futex list

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Size of the structure pointed to by head, should be sizeof(*head)

return_value.failure: Returns an error code on failure

errors.description: len does not equal sizeof(struct robust_list_head)
